name: Circle Yetu
imageAlt: Circle Point Creator Hub store design preview for Circle Yetu
description: Creator platform for turning a bio into a storefront, with digital products, 1-on-1 bookings, direct tips, and M-Pesa or card payments built in.
longDescription: Circle Yetu helps creators turn their bio into a bank account. The platform lets creators sell e-books, templates, courses, and other digital products with automatic email delivery after M-Pesa or card payment. Creators can also take 1-on-1 bookings that sync with Google Calendar and collect direct tips through M-Pesa.
